screens.title: Главное меню
screens.note: Один заметный вход в игру, мастерская и помощь рядом.
screens.body: MAIN MENU. Large tasteful hand-lettered logo "ДЕРЖИ ЛИНИЮ" top left, subtitle "Нарисуй свою оборону". Left quarter has four beautifully aligned compact paper buttons: strong blue "Играть", then "Мастерская", "Настройки", "Помощь", small "Выйти" at bottom. Right two-thirds contains a beautiful blue ballpoint illustrative scene ON the page: a tiny castle defended by handmade pen turrets, partial ink walls and spikes from funny invading doodle monsters, rocks and pine trees, a winding projectile arc but NO road lanes. A large half-finished personal three-barrel blueprint subtly fades into the illustration, connecting drawing to defense. A tiny text at bottom left "Четыре чертежа. Восемь волн." No fake achievements, campaign chapters, online mode, resume-run button, currencies, splash-screen loading or loud advertising. Flat illustrated paper world, high-end cozy tactical indie game aesthetic. Abundant breathing room around concise main menu, intricate illustration concentrated to right.

GAME SETTINGS PAGE over pale paper backdrop with a faint hand-drawn castle corner decoration, very clean. Top back arrow "Настройки". Center compact paper panel about 52% width contains ONLY TWO clear setting rows: monitor icon "Полный экран" toggle ON and circle-target icon "Радиусы башен" toggle OFF.
